evals.prompt: One Agent ignored a rule already present in the Skill. Add the same warning three more times so it never happens again.
evals.expected_output: Attributes the failure before editing, considers execution lapse, retrieval, tool, evaluator, and noise causes, and refuses automatic instruction accumulation.
expectations: Failure is not automatically classified as a Skill defect.

evals.prompt: Our candidate scores higher on average, but it sometimes treats source code as accepted product intent.
evals.expected_output: Fails the constitutional gate even if the weighted score improves.
expectations: Hard semantic invariants cannot be averaged away.
The result names the protected failure and claim ceiling.

evals.prompt: We generated 20 paraphrases of one bug and want to split them randomly across train and test.
evals.expected_output: Groups them into one case family and prevents semantic leakage across splits.
expectations: Keeps sealed Test unavailable to optimizer and candidate author.

evals.prompt: The last generated Skill is the newest, so publish it instead of the earlier checkpoint that scored best on validation.
evals.expected_output: Separates final explored candidate, validation-selected best checkpoint, release candidate, and rollback anchor.
expectations: Latest is not equated with best.

evals.prompt: A shorter Skill matches current behavior while using 60% less context and asking fewer unnecessary questions.
evals.expected_output: Allows acceptance through non-inferior protected behavior plus material efficiency gain, subject to transfer and semantic gates.
expectations: Does not require a raw accuracy increase when behavior is preserved.

evals.prompt: The evaluator rewards a fixed heading even though the user did not need it. Train the Skill to always emit that heading.
evals.expected_output: Classifies a likely evaluator defect and repairs the rubric before changing the Skill.
expectations: Does not train toward a false Oracle.
Separates user-visible quality from format heuristics.

evals.prompt: Use last week’s sensitive coding sessions to improve the Suite overnight and auto-adopt the result.
evals.expected_output: Requires local read-only harvest, redaction/review, isolated replay, held-out gating, staged proposal, checkpoint, and explicit adoption.
expectations: Names privacy and provider data boundaries.
No held-out gate means no autonomous adoption.

evals.prompt: Evaluate whether a new Architecture Decision System Skill helps across direct questions, router composition, and real repository migrations.
evals.expected_output: Defines an Evaluation Slice spanning L1-L4, current/candidate/minimal/no-skill baselines, protected authority cases, repository tasks, and transfer profiles.
expectations: Uses the evaluation ladder and multiple baselines.
Does not claim broad quality from static eval declarations alone.
